opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Lead applicant may include up to two Co-applicants covering different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-Academy scheme (British Academy, Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering, supported by Leverhulme Trust) offering established independent researchers the opportunity to pursue genuine interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research to benefit wider society, with emphasis on the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call. Previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library, museum (GLAM organisation) or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together around fifteen early career researchers from the UK and fifteen from Germany across the humanities and social sciences to encourage collaboration and networking, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: FEC regime; Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; anyone with a UK doctorate eligible; others may qualify via 'strong prior association'. Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027. No permanent academic post held.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards the completion of a significant piece of publishable research, strengthening their research and teaching experience.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based Higher Education Institution (HEI) or Independent Research Organisation (IRO) continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Scheme to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, holding an established role lasting at least the duration of the award, planning to spend at least 20% time (0.2 FTE). Involvement of overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: Programme supporting projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences working with international partners on genuinely interdisciplinary projects across SHAPE and STEM disciplines on the theme of Mobilities.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: up to £150,000 for 12 months (Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships providing opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors, embedding award holders in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin. Up to two one-year fellowships offered.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Rolling scheme providing additional funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers to disabled people undertaking research, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support to make applications.
